usage: Yun1 joeng1 (鴛鴦) is a noun referring to a popular drink mixing coffee and milk tea in Hong Kong.
You can use yun1 joeng1 to order this mixed drink at cafes or cha chaan tengs.
It is usually not modified by adjectives because it refers to a specific drink combination.
Yun1 joeng1 is often used as a standalone word when talking about drinks.

examples.meaning: I want to drink a cup of coffee and milk tea mix.
